web.privacy: Files you select are read and stored only inside this browser.
web.soundHint: Tap the screen once to turn on sound
web.quota: The browser is out of storage space
web.storeFailed: Could not add the game file to the library ({reason}). It will only run this time
web.noStore: This browser cannot use storage (IndexedDB), so game files and saves will not be kept. If this is a private window, open the page in a normal window
web.storageNote:

web.zip.pickText: Choose the games in {name} to add to the library. Added games don't start right away.
web.zip.stopped: Adding was cancelled. The {count} games already added stay in the library
web.doc.failed: Could not load the document ({reason}). Check your internet connection.
web.lib.empty: Your library is empty. Running a game adds its cartridge here.
web.zipNoGame: There is no game file (.gba · .gb · .gbc · .wgba) in {rom}
web.lib.missing: The game was not found in the library. Please open the file again
web.lib.deleteText: {name} will be removed from this browser, along with its quick slots. Its save stays.
web.save.importText: {name} will be overwritten with the contents of {file}. The current save is lost, and a running game restarts.
web.save.deleteText: {name} will be deleted. This cannot be undone, so export it first.
web.save.deleteRunning: {name} will be deleted. The running game creates it again when it saves. This cannot be undone, so export it first.
web.saveFail.title: Could not keep the save
web.saveFail.text: {reason}. The game goes on, but the save may not be kept in this browser. Export the current save from the Saves menu.
web.wasmRom.title: A ROM is needed
web.wasmRom.text: {name} has no ROM inside. Choose the ROM (.gba) to use with this web build.
web.needsGlue: This wasm needs the .js built with it, so the web version cannot open it{why}
web.patch.intro: {name} has no ROM inside. Choose a ROM file you own to make the game, add it to your library and open it.
web.patch.overwrite: {name} in your library differs from what {patch} makes. Make it again and replace it? Saves stay.
web.dirInput.note: The stick follows your finger; the D-pad uses the arm you press
web.pad.note: Shows on-screen buttons. Overlay lays them over the game in landscape.
web.pad.place.note: Choose how controls are placed. Custom lets you drag them freely on screen.
web.pad.edit.help2: Drag to move · corner to resize · edges for width or height · color below.
web.padCombo.note: Pressing between A and B presses both
web.rs.noGame: Start a game to set steps per game
web.rs.emptyPress: This preset has no steps. Add them in Settings › RS button.
web.vibrate.note: A short vibration when you press a game button
web.vibrateDir.note: A short vibration when the stick or D-pad direction changes
web.wakeLock.note: Stops the screen from turning off while you play
web.pauseWhenHidden.note: Switching to another app or tab pauses the game and stores the save.
web.help.touch: On-screen buttons work with several fingers at once, and sliding on the D-pad changes direction. Games that use a mouse are played by touching the screen.
web.help.gamepad: Gamepads use the standard layout (press any button once to connect).
web.info.about: A GBA · GB · GBC player that runs in the browser. .gba · .gb · .gbc · .zip run on the mGBA core, and .wgba · .wasm on the built-in host. No ROMs, game files or official BIOS are included (mGBA's built-in HLE BIOS is used).
info.others: Tabler Icons (MIT), pako (MIT AND Zlib), jsQR (Apache-2.0), Galmuri font (SIL OFL 1.1, © Lee Minseo).
host.embedFormat: This webGBA does not know this built-in ROM format (format {version} · method {method}). Reload the page to get the new version
patch.err.patchVersion: {name} uses a patch format this webGBA does not know (format {version}). Reload the page to get the new version
patch.err.romModified: {rom} is the same game ({title} · {code} · rev {revision}) but a modified ROM (SHA-1 {sha1}…). An original ROM without patches, cheats or edits is needed — usable ROMs: {need}
web.name.title: Name in the library
web.name.text: The game made from {patch} goes into your library under this name. Leave it empty to use the default name.
web.name.rule: Up to {max} characters · \ / : * ? " < > | are not allowed
web.name.bad: \ / : * ? " < > | and control characters are not allowed
web.name.long: Names can be up to {max} characters
web.name.takenText: {name} is already in your library. Overwriting replaces that game file and keeps using its save.
web.rename.text: Changes the display name of {name}. Its save carries on.
web.start.pickDrop: Select a game file or drop it here.
web.gate.title: Install webGBA as an app
web.gate.lead: To keep your game files and saves safe on this device, webGBA runs only as an installed app.
web.gate.iosShare: Tap the Share button at the bottom (or top) of Safari.
web.gate.iosAdd: Choose 'Add to Home Screen', then tap 'Add'.
web.gate.iosOpen: Open webGBA from its icon on the Home Screen.
web.gate.openSafari: Open this address in Safari. Other browsers and in-app browsers cannot install it.
web.gate.openChrome: Open this address in Chrome. In-app browsers cannot install it.
web.gate.androidMenu: Tap the menu (⋮) at the top right.
web.gate.androidInstall: Choose 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
web.gate.openApp: Open webGBA from the installed icon.
web.gate.desktopInstall: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar, or choose 'Install app' in the menu.
web.gate.desktopOpen: Play in the webGBA window that opens after installing.
web.gate.macDock: Choose File → 'Add to Dock' in the menu bar.
web.gate.unsupported: This browser cannot install apps. Please open this page in Chrome or Edge.
web.gate.installed: Installed. Open webGBA from your Home screen or app list.
web.quick.noteAuto: Slot 9 is for auto save only. It is overwritten every {n} min of play (Settings › Auto save).
web.quick.noteAutoOff: Slot 9 is for auto save only. Auto save is off now (Settings › Auto save).
web.quick.noteSav: Quick slots are kept apart from the in-game save (.sav). Loading one leaves the .sav as it is; it changes when you save in the game afterwards.
web.quick.noState: Quick slots are not available for this game
web.quick.overText: What you saved at {time} will be replaced.
web.quick.loadText: You go back to where you were at {time}. Progress since then is lost.
web.quick.loadedSave: {slot} was saved by another version: continuing on the field from that time
web.quick.loadFailed: Could not load. The slot may come from another game or core
web.autoSave.note: Overwrites quick slot 9, counting play time only
web.wgba.olderText: {name}: your library has {now}, and this file is the older {version}. Change to the older version? Saves and quick slots carry over
web.wgba.migrated: {name} {version} — took over the saves and quick slots of the old .wgba
web.wgba.moveFailed: Could not move the old saves, so the old entry was kept and the game was added separately
web.lib.pick: Tap a cartridge to take it out
web.wgba.olderOldText: {name}: your library has {now}, and this file is an old .wgba with no version. Change to the old file? Saves and quick slots carry over
web.wgba.migratedSave: {name} {version} — took over the save of the old .wgba
web.wgba.migratedStates: {name} {version} — took over the quick slots of the old .wgba
wgba.newer: This .wgba was made with a newer format. Reload the page to get the new version
web.closeAsk.title: Quit the game?
web.closeAsk.text: Progress not saved inside the game will be lost.
web.wapk.turnLandscapeText: This game runs only in landscape. If rotation lock is on, turn it off.
web.wapk.turnPortraitText: This game runs only in portrait. If rotation lock is on, turn it off.
web.wapk.keysNeeded: This game needs a keyboard or a gamepad
web.sf.title: Screen filter
web.sf.scope.noteGlobal: Changes apply to all games (except games with their own setting).
web.sf.scope.noteWapk: Android apps (.wapk) do not use the all-games setting (off by default). A change creates a setting for this game.
web.sf.ban.startText: Changes apply to all games and show on the game screen as soon as a game starts.
web.sf.ban.cssText: {name} draws its own screen (② script), so Scale and Screen are not supported.
web.sf.ban.heavyText: This combination is heavy ({what}). If it stutters, switch to a lighter method.
web.sf.ban.slowText: Frame target missed for 3 seconds or more. If it stutters, switch to a lighter method.
web.sf.ban.ffTextPhone: Ghosting off · heavy scaling shown as original pixels (setting kept)
web.sf.ban.glText: This device cannot show Scale and Screen filters, so the original screen is used.
web.sf.toast.gl: WebGL2 is unavailable, showing the screen without filters
web.sf.secs: Scale · Effect · Screen — bar = strength, name = details
web.sf.lockedTitle: {name}: not supported for this game type
web.sf.emptyNeutral: {name} is off. Select a filter above to show its details.
web.sf.emptyNone: {name} has no details. Adjust it with the strength bar.
web.sf.defaultTitle: Reset {name} details and strength to default
web.sf.saveText: Saves the current Scale · Effect · Screen settings as a preset. Up to {max} user presets.
web.sf.saveFull: All {max} in use. Select a preset to overwrite
web.sf.releaseText: This game will also use the all-games setting ({label}).
web.sf.released: Removed the game setting. Using the all-games setting
web.sf.resetTitle: Restore the screen filter to original for all games?
web.sf.resetText: Game settings and user presets are kept.
web.sf.resetDone: Restored the screen filter to original for all games
web.sf.deleteText: A deleted preset cannot be restored. The current screen setting is kept.
web.sf.made: Created a setting for {name}. Further changes apply only to this game
web.sf.undone: Restored the settings from when the panel opened
web.sf.cfgGamesNote: {n} games have their own setting. Delete to use the all-games setting
web.sf.cfgGamesNone: No game has its own setting
web.sf.f.scale.nearest.desc: Nearest-neighbor scaling (same as webGBA so far). At fit-to-area scales, pixel widths can differ by 1px.
web.sf.f.scale.sharp.desc: Keeps pixel widths even without integer scaling. Only pixel edges are interpolated.
web.sf.f.scale.bilinear.desc: Removes jaggies and softens the whole screen. Suits N64 · PS1 3D screens.
web.sf.f.scale.sharpen.desc: Scales softly, then raises edge contrast. Suits blurry 3D screens.
web.sf.f.scale.smooth.desc: Detects pixel steps and draws smooth diagonals and curves.
web.sf.f.scale.toon.desc: Scales smoothly, reduces color steps and draws dark outlines. Looks like an illustration.
web.sf.f.color.gray.desc: Removes color and keeps only brightness.
web.sf.f.color.sepia.desc: A brown tone like an old photo.
web.sf.f.color.dmg.desc: Reduces brightness to the green levels of the original Game Boy.
web.sf.f.color.satcon.desc: Adjusts saturation, contrast and brightness. Suits dark games.
web.sf.f.color.cvd.desc: Moves hard-to-tell color differences to colors that are easier to tell apart.
web.sf.f.display.crt.desc: Recreates a CRT TV with scanlines, curvature and bloom. Suits arcade · PS1.
web.sf.f.display.lcd.desc: Recreates the GBA screen with pixel gaps and LCD color.
web.sf.f.display.dot.desc: Recreates the original Game Boy screen with round dots on a paper-colored base.
web.sf.f.display.ghost.desc: Keeps the previous frame to recreate the slow response of handheld LCDs.
web.sf.d.scale.sharp.edge.desc: Width of the interpolated pixel edge
web.sf.d.scale.sharpen.amount.desc: How much edge contrast is raised
web.sf.d.scale.smooth.sfxEdge.desc: Edge width when fitting the ScaleFX result to the screen
web.sf.d.scale.smooth.xbrEdge.desc: Diagonal detection width. Larger is softer
web.sf.d.scale.smooth.aa.desc: On = half blend with the original (AAScale2x)
web.sf.d.scale.toon.levels.desc: Number of brightness levels for surfaces
web.sf.m.omni: hqx-style pattern detection. One pass at any scale
web.sf.m.scalefx: Most precise edge interpolation. Original colors only, 6 passes
web.sf.m.xbr: Detects edge direction and connects diagonals. 1 pass
web.sf.m.hq2x: The original hqx. Pattern interpolation at 2x
web.sf.d.color.dmg.dither.desc: How much levels are mixed with a dot pattern
web.sf.d.color.cvd.mode.desc0: Makes color differences easier to tell apart
web.sf.d.color.cvd.mode.desc1: Preview of color-deficient vision (for making and checking games)
web.sf.d.display.crt.curve.desc: How much the screen edges bend
web.sf.d.display.crt.corner.desc: Roundness of the four corners. The outer border uses the same radius
web.sf.d.display.crt.mask.desc: Strength of the RGB vertical pattern
web.sf.d.display.lcd.ghost.desc: How much the previous frame stays during motion
web.sf.d.display.dot.size.desc: Size of the dot within a cell
web.sf.d.display.dot.shadow.desc: Strength of the shadow under dots
web.sf.d.display.dot.ghost.desc: How much the previous frame stays during motion
web.sf.d.display.ghost.amount.desc: How much the previous frame stays
web.sf.lock.dither: Dither is not supported for this game type
web.sf.lock.curve: Touch games keep a flat screen so touch positions match
